visual_action: The video opens on a close-up of Donald Trump smiling in a crowd under blue and purple lighting. It then cuts to various shots of people dancing energetically in a dark, club-like setting with similar blue lighting. The video concludes with black-and-white shots of the White House and a helicopter, followed by a final shot of the White House at night.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is shown in a smiling close-up at the beginning of the video.

cast.name: The White House
cast.evidence: The text 'THE WHITE HOUSE' and images of the building appear at the end of the video. The video was posted by the @whitehouse account.

on_screen_text.text: When someone says America is the hottest country anywhere in the world

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue. The audio is an upbeat electronic pop song with lyrics including "I said, ooh, ooh, come on, baby, turn the lights off."
audio_music: An upbeat, energetic electronic dance-pop song, 'Turn the Lights Off' by Tally Hall, is used to create a celebratory and party-like atmosphere.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a fast-paced montage with quick cuts between different shots of people dancing.
cultural_references: The video uses a common meme format of 'When [situation], [reaction footage].'
central_claim: America, under the leadership represented by Donald Trump and the White House, is the most exciting and celebrated country in the world.
intended_effect: To evoke feelings of national pride and associate the administration with energy, popularity, and celebration.
